name: geenie-ai-skills
description: Portable agent skills by Geenie-AI. Each skill is a plain Agent Skills folder that runs unchanged in Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Kiro and any other host that reads SKILL.md; this marketplace exposes each one as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: agentic-architect
plugins.description: Designs a new agentic solution or diagnoses and improves an existing one (a prompt, a skill set, a skill-to-agent assignment, an agent, the knowledge layer, or a whole system) for Claude Code, Claude Agent SDK, Claude API, OpenAI Agents SDK, OpenAI Responses API, Codex, or a generic framework, following OpenAI's Optimizing LLM Accuracy method. Use when asked to design, architect, review, optimize, or fix prompts, skills, agents, retrieval, or multi-agent pipelines, or when a pipeline hallucinates, ignores its schema, or needs an eval plan.
